items.title: Hun har flere lyttere end The Minds of 99. Hvornår opdager Danmark hende for alvor?
items.summary: Fine Glindvad Jensen er allerede en sensation ude i verden. Med hendes fremragende nye album burde danskerne opdage hende for alvor. Og finde ud af, hvor meget vi har brug for det, hun kan.
items.titleEn: She has more listeners than The Minds of 99. When will Denmark really discover her?
items.summaryEn: Fine Glindvad Jensen is already a sensation around the world. With her excellent new album, the Danes should really discover her. And find out how much we need what she can.

items.title: Ekstraordinært antal skinnefejl fører til omfattende forsinkelser
items.summary: Regionaltog aflyses, og tog skal køre langsommere, efter at Banedanmark har registreret højt antal skinnefejl.
items.titleEn: Extraordinary number of skid errors leads to extensive delays
items.summaryEn: Regional trains will be cancelled and trains will have to run more slowly after Banedanmark has registered a high number of skid errors.

items.title: Mange danskere har slet ikke forberedt sig på de digitale kriser. Nu kommer eksperter med flere gode råd
items.summary: Vi er måske blevet bedre til hjemmeberedskab. Men hvad med det digitale beredskab? Et nedbrud hos Microsoft blev en påmindelse om behovet for backup og alternativer.
items.titleEn: Many Danes have not prepared themselves for the digital crisis. Now experts come with some good advice
items.summaryEn: Maybe we've gotten better at home preparation. But what about the digital emergency? A breakdown at Microsoft became a reminder of the need for backup and alternatives.

items.title: Andersson: Mindretalsregering er inden for rækkevidde
items.summary: Socialdemokraterna vil danne en ny regering med Miljöpartiet og Centerpartiet og samarbejde med venstreparti.
items.titleEn: Andersson: Minority government is within reach
items.summaryEn: The Social Democrats will form a new government with the Miljö Party and the Centre Party and cooperate with the Left Party.

items.title: Efter anklager om grooming og overgreb: Nu går politiet ind i sagen om britisk tv-stjerne
items.summary: David Walliams erkender at have opført sig tankeløst over for personer, han havde uforpligtende forhold til.
items.titleEn: Following allegations of grooming and assault, police are now entering the case of the British TV star
items.summaryEn: David Walliams admits that he acted thoughtlessly toward people with whom he had an uncompromising relationship.

items.title: Nvidia-skandalen har sat gang i et ophedet opgør i Trumps regering
items.summary: Handelsminister Howard Lutnick beskyldes for at have forhalet eksportkontrol med mikrochips til Kina, mens også Trumps eget tætte forhold til Jensen Huang rejser spørgsmål.
items.titleEn: The Nvidia scandal has sparked a heated uproar in the Trump administration.
items.summaryEn: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick is accused of having facilitated export controls with microchips to China, while Trump's own close relationship with Jensen Huang raises questions.

items.title: Det er en værdig og bevægende afslutning
items.summary: Roy Jacobsens posthumt udgivne roman er en levende beskrivelse af alderdom, sygdom og kampen for at huske og tænke klart.
items.titleEn: It's a worthy and moving ending.
items.summaryEn: Roy Jacobsen's posthumously published novel is a vivid account of old age, illness, and the struggle to remember and think clearly.

items.title: Moderaterne afviste at sænke benzinpriserne. Nu kan det ikke gå hurtigt nok
items.summary: Efter at have afvist at sænke benzinpriserne, mener skatteminister Jakob Engel-Schmidt (M) nu, at det ikke kan vente til efter jul. Politiken har spurgt ham, hvorfor det pludselig er blevet en hastesag.
items.titleEn: The moderates refused to lower gas prices. Now it can't go fast enough
items.summaryEn: After refusing to lower petrol prices, the tax minister, Jakob Engel-Schmidt (M), now believes that it cannot wait until after Christmas. Politics has asked him why this has suddenly become an emergency.

items.title: Jeg blev desværre aldrig fuld nok til helt at tro på ham
items.summary: Den fascinerende fortælling om Vladimir Putins politiske rådgiver Vladislav Surkov ender på Sorte Hest som en demonstration af luftkasteller.
items.titleEn: Unfortunately, I never got drunk enough to completely believe in him.
items.summaryEn: The fascinating story of Vladimir Putin's political adviser Vladislav Surkov ends on the Black Horse as a demonstration of air castles.

items.title: Russisk blogger: »Vi står over for en katastrofal situation«
items.summary: Tilhængerne af krigen mod naboerne har ikke haft ondt af de civiles problemer i Ukraine, når strømforsyningen afbrydes af angreb. Til gengæld taler de nødig om det, der rammer deres egen side.
items.titleEn: Russian blogger:  ⁇ We are facing a catastrophic situation ⁇
items.summaryEn: Supporters of the war against the neighbors have not felt sorry for the problems of civilians in Ukraine when the power supply is cut off by attacks. In return, they do not talk about what strikes their own side.

items.title: Fem lande skal stå i spidsen for Europa. På topmøde besluttede EU, hvem der skal sidde med ved forhandlingsbordet
items.summary: EUs medlemslande er enige: EU-institutionerne og E5-magterne skal repræsentere Europa ved fredsforhandlingerne, fortæller Antonio Costa efter topmøde i Dublin.
items.titleEn: Five countries must lead Europe. At the summit, the EU decided who should sit at the negotiating table
items.summaryEn: EU Member States agree: the EU institutions and the E5 must represent Europe in peace negotiations, Antonio Costa told the Dublin summit.

items.title: Nedbrud på Microsoft-tjenester skyldes opdatering

items.title: Europa har sat sit hold til Ukraine-fredsforhandlinger

items.titleEn: Europe has joined the Ukrainian peace negotiations
items.summaryEn: Poland and Italy are being shut out of the partnership of countries to represent Europe in negotiations.

items.title: Nu skal »skønhedskonkurrencen« afgøres: Begge svenske statsministerkandidater har afleveret sin totalplan til partiet i midten
items.summary: Både Socialdemokraterna og Moderaterna har fredag afleveret en såkaldt totalplan til Centerpartiet, der har de afgørende stemmer i forhold til at danne regering. Og begge statsministerkandidater tror nu på, at de kan…
items.titleEn: Now to decide the beauty contest: Both Swedish prime minister candidates have submitted their overall plan to the party in the middle.
items.summaryEn: Both the Social Democrats and the Moderates on Friday submitted a so-called 'total plan' to the Centre Party, which has the decisive votes to form a government. And both candidates for prime minister now believe they can...

items.title: I dag skulle have været dommedag. Forskere frygtede, at vi ville blive »klemt ihjel«
items.summary: I 1960 frygtede en gruppe forskere, at verdens befolkning ville vokse sig så stor, at det ville blive vores undergang. Forudsigelsen rummer en vigtig lektie for os i dag.
items.titleEn: Today was supposed to be the day of judgment. Scientists feared we'd be killed by the clutches.
items.summaryEn: In 1960, a group of scientists feared that the world's population would grow so large that we would perish. The prophecy contains an important lesson for us today.

items.title: Novo får europæisk tilladelse til salg af blødermiddel
items.summary: Novo har fået godkendelse fra EU-Kommissionen til at sælge blødermidlet Frehemgo til patienter med hæmofili A.
items.titleEn: Novo receives a European authorisation for the sale of bleeding agents
items.summaryEn: Novo has been authorised by the European Commission to sell Frehemgo to patients with haemophilia A.

items.summaryEn: 21-year-old Theodor Storm will join ColoQuick when his contract with Netcompany Ineos expires at the end of the year.
